Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.view

Class EndStage

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.view.EndStage
public class EndStage extends Object
EndStage is a utility class that manages the end-game view and scene. This class handles loading the end-game FXML file, displaying game results, and managing transitions back to menu or rematch.
